texts: Cumulative LoE of AR 2026–2050, Theoretical Limit
New Zealand population 2050 (million), Monte Carlo draws
P(cumulative LoE of AR ≤ 1), Theoretical Limit
note: P(within AR) = 0.000 (Wilson 0.000-0.001); (b) 2 of 5,000 draws have TL within AR, fewer than 10 (10 events per variable; Peduzzi et al. 1996): the population threshold is not estimable; the LoE distribution against the 2050 population is shown instead. L1 at TL combines the lowest observed census headship of each age group (or propensity B where lower): 4.0% fewer households per person than the 2023 rates in 2050. With the v4.10 setting (the national 1991 household size 2.79 regardless of age, 11.7% fewer households per person at every age) TL is 4,177 kt, LoE AR 0.94, P(LoE AR ≤ 1) = 60.9% over the draws (sensitivity row).
